description: This is a Java unit test source file for the {@link ThingPersistenceActor} class in the Eclipse Ditto project. It contains multiple test cases verifying the behavior of the persistent actor managing 'things', including creation, modification, retrieval, deletion, and recovery scenarios, as well as handling of permissions, sequence numbers, and version compatibility.

classes.name: ThingPersistenceActorTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class containing multiple test cases to verify the correct behavior of the ThingPersistenceActor concerning creation, modification, retrieval, deletion, and recovery of 'things', as well as scenario coverage for permissions, versioning, sequence correctness, and error handling.

methods.name: unavailableExpectedIfPersistenceActorTerminates
methods.description: Verifies that a retrieval request after the actor terminates results in a ThingUnavailableException.

methods.name: tryToModifyFeaturePropertyAndReceiveCorrectErrorCode
methods.description: Tests that attempting to modify a feature property without access results in an appropriate error code.

methods.name: tryToRetrieveThingWhichWasNotYetCreated
methods.description: Ensures that retrieving a non-existent thing produces a ThingNotAccessibleException.

methods.name: tryToCreateThingWithDifferentThingId
methods.description: Checks that commands with mismatched actor and command thing IDs throw an IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: createThingV2
methods.description: Verifies creation of a new thing in version 2 format.

methods.name: modifyThingV1
methods.description: Tests modifying a thing in version 1 format.

methods.name: modifyThingV2
methods.description: Tests modifying a thing in version 2 format.

methods.name: doTestModifyThingKeepsOverwritesExistingFirstLevelFieldsWhenExplicitlySpecified
methods.description: Checks proper overwriting of first-level fields during a modification when explicitly specified.

methods.name: modifyThingKeepsOverwritesExistingFirstLevelFieldsWhenExplicitlySpecified
methods.description: A helper that verifies overwriting behavior for first-level fields during modification.

methods.name: modifyThingKeepsAlreadyExistingFirstLevelFieldsWhenNotExplicitlyOverwritten
methods.description: Tests that existing first-level fields are retained when not overwritten in modifications.

methods.name: doTestModifyThingKeepsAlreadyExistingFirstLevelFieldsWhenNotExplicitlyOverwritten
methods.description: Auxiliary method for the above, to check retention of fields.

methods.name: modifyAttributeSoThatThingGetsTooLarge
methods.description: Tests that attempting to modify a thing with an attribute that causes the size limit to be exceeded results in ThingTooLargeException.

methods.name: retrieveThingV2
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of a version 2 format thing.

methods.name: retrieveThingsWithoutThingIdOfActor
methods.description: Checks retrieving multiple things with unrelated IDs results in no message.

methods.name: deleteThingV1
methods.description: Tests deletion of a thing in version 1 format.

methods.name: deleteThingV2
methods.description: Tests deletion of a thing in version 2 format.

methods.name: deleteAndRecreateThingWithMinimumData
methods.description: Verifies that after deletion, recreating with minimal data results in a clean state.

methods.name: modifyFeatures
methods.description: Tests adding/modifying features on a thing.

methods.name: modifyAttributes
methods.description: Tests adding/modifying attributes on a thing.

methods.name: modifyAttribute
methods.description: Verifies modifying an individual attribute.

methods.name: retrieveAttribute
methods.description: Tests retrieving a specific attribute.

methods.name: deleteAttribute
methods.description: Tests deleting a specific attribute.

methods.name: tryToRetrieveThingAfterDeletion
methods.description: Ensures retrieving a deleted thing results in access exception.

methods.name: recoverThingCreated
methods.description: Verifies actor recovery after creating a thing and restart.

methods.name: recoverThingDeleted
methods.description: Verifies actor recovery after deleting a thing and restart.

methods.name: recoverAclModified
methods.description: Verifies recovery of modified ACL after restart.

methods.name: recoverAclEntryModified
methods.description: Verifies recovery of modified ACL entry after restart.

methods.name: recoverAclEntryDeleted
methods.description: Verifies recovery after ACL entry deletion and restart.

methods.name: ensureSequenceNumberCorrectness
methods.description: Checks correctness of sequence numbers after creation and modification.

methods.name: ensureSequenceNumberCorrectnessAfterRecovery
methods.description: Checks sequence number correctness after actor recovery.

methods.name: createThingInV1AndRetrieveWithV1
methods.description: Ensures creation and retrieval of a thing in version 1 in the same format.

methods.name: createThingInV1AndRetrieveWithV2
methods.description: Ensures creation in V1 format and retrieval with V2 headers.

methods.name: createThingInV1AndUpdateWithV2
methods.description: Tests updating a V1 formatted thing with a V2 modification.

methods.name: createThingInV2WithMissingPolicyIdThrowsPolicyIdMissingException
methods.description: Verifies that creating a V2 thing without a policy ID throws PolicyIdMissingException.

methods.name: responsesDuringInitializationAreSentWithDittoHeaders
methods.description: Tests that responses during initialization include the correct Ditto headers.

methods.name: ensureModifiedCorrectnessAfterCreation
methods.description: Checks that modification timestamps are correctly set after creation.

methods.name: ensureModifiedCorrectnessAfterModification
methods.description: Verifies timestamps correctness after modifications.
